name: io.github.ShaanGS/ventriloquist
title: Ventriloquist
description: Turn Mac apps into MCP tools via the accessibility API: no screenshots, no model per step.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_ALLOW_HIGH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow tools a pack marks as high risk. They are refused otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_HEAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the server call a model to re-ground broken anchors. Off keeps serving model-free.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for your own packs and traces. Defaults to ~/.ventriloquist.
